aiSpecs.panelTitle: Seo mochine ona o ka se etsang ka nnete
aiSpecs.panelSubtitle: Dintlha di fetoletswe mosebetsing wa sebele — di tswa ho didirisiwa tse phatlaladitsweng ke moetsi, e seng papatsong.

npu.label: NPU
npu.outcomeHigh: Meets the Copilot+ requirement, so live translation, background blur and on-device assistants run locally instead of in the cloud.
npu.outcomeBase: Handles everyday AI features like noise removal and camera effects without draining the battery.
npu.tooltip: TOPS = trillions of AI operations per second. 40+ TOPS is Microsoft's Copilot+ bar; below that, AI features still work but lean on the cloud.

gpu.label: Graphics
gpu.outcome: Enough graphics power for local image generation, video editing and model fine-tuning.
gpu.tooltip: The graphics chip does the heavy lifting for image, video and AI model work. A dedicated GPU is far faster than built-in graphics.

ram.label: Memory
ram.outcomeHigh: Room to run large local AI models and heavy multitasking at the same time.
ram.outcomeMid: Comfortable for local AI assistants, big spreadsheets and dozens of browser tabs.
ram.outcomeBase: Fine for everyday study and office work; tight for large local AI models.
ram.tooltip: RAM is the workspace your machine thinks in. Local AI models must fit in it — 16GB is the practical floor, 32GB+ is comfortable.

copilot_plus.label: Copilot+ ready
copilot_plus.blurb: 40+ TOPS NPU, so Windows AI features run on the device.
copilot_plus.tooltip: Microsoft requires a 40 TOPS NPU for Copilot+ features like Recall, Live Captions and Cocreator.

video_rendering.label: Great for video rendering
video_rendering.blurb: Dedicated graphics and memory headroom for timeline exports.
video_rendering.tooltip: Video exports lean on the GPU. This hardware shortens render waits in Premiere, DaVinci Resolve and CapCut.

image_generation.label: Local image generation
image_generation.blurb: Runs Stable Diffusion-class models without a subscription.
image_generation.tooltip: Enough graphics memory to generate images on your own machine instead of paying per image in the cloud.

data_science.label: Ideal for data science
data_science.blurb: Memory and compute for large datasets and model training.
data_science.tooltip: Suited to pandas, notebooks and training smaller models locally without waiting on shared servers.

student_essentials.label: Student essentials
student_essentials.blurb: Everything needed for research, writing and online classes.
student_essentials.tooltip: Comfortably handles browser research, documents, video calls and light AI study tools.

all_day_battery_ai.label: All-day AI on battery
all_day_battery_ai.blurb: Efficient NPU keeps AI features on without killing runtime.
all_day_battery_ai.tooltip: The NPU runs AI tasks at a fraction of the power the main processor would use, so battery life survives.

recommendWhy.intro: Re sebedisa matshwao a mane mme re emisa ho la pele le fanang ka dihlahiswa tse lekaneng tse teng katalokong ya hao:
recommendWhy.tier1Text: what real customers paid for alongside this item.
recommendWhy.tier2Text: a hand-maintained map of which category pairs with which (a laptop pulls docks, monitors and storage, never more laptops).
recommendWhy.tier3Label: Disebediswa tsa mofuta o le mong
recommendWhy.tier4Text: in this catalogue, when the item is too new to have any history.
recommendWhy.hasHistorySuffix: came from actual order history. The rest are complements.
recommendWhy.noHistory: This product has no purchase history yet, so everything below comes from the complement rules rather than from other shoppers.
